scope: Separate post-confirmation correctness-only extension; never a timing replacement or denominator
frozen_production_binaries: Same G0/G1 hashes as SOURCE_PINS.json; no rebuild or adapter modification
targeted_query: Self query at the last allocated nonempty leaf of each pinned synthetic index; GPU leaves execute in parallel, so this is not a total device-visit-order certificate
quality: Independent exhaustive reference, legal exact ties, original distance field tolerance, sorted nonnegative complete fields and bit-identical G0/G1 outputs
fault_rule: Stop at first unexpected runtime/quality failure; retain all evidence, no favorable replacements
not_certified: Original root-leaf N<K result semantics and arbitrary externally edited alias indexes remain unsupported; rejection is not successful full search
